decisions.reason: Questions are now too generic ("What did the mound contain", "Which kind of item"); they would equally be answered "modern artifacts" (acq-event_025-03) and do not ask for exactly "portrait of a future President".

Questions ("What did the artifacts spark", "What reaction followed the discovery") are generic and match sibling answers (e.g. time travel theories, conspiracy theorists); they do not ask for exactly "international intrigue".
